name: maintain-product
job: Cut live or regression harm with a root-cause fix on the owning layer and an oracle proving harm reduction.

inScope: Framing symptom, severity, audience, and health signal
Reproducing and bisecting to root cause
Fixing cause on the owning layer with regression locks
Verifying oracle green or reduced harm
outOfScope: Feature expansion or visual redesign without a harm link
Papering over shared floors in the wrong layer

inputs: Live or regression symptom with severity and audience
Logs, tests, live smoke, and reports
Health signal that must improve this cycle
outputs: Root-cause fix with regression test or smoke where automatable
Oracle rerun showing green or reduced harm

data: evidence: logs, tests, live smoke, reports
permissions: delivery access on the owning layer

failureSemantics: The cycle is not done until the framed harm is fixed or mitigated with evidence, reproduction is closed or a residual owner is named, and no obvious new regression appears on the touched path.

outcome.observable: The failing oracle reruns green or harm measurably reduces, reproduction is closed or owned, and the touched path shows no obvious new regression.
